solves.reasoning: (A) 'they serve simply to illustrate' → illustrate가 원문. (B) 'which has been advanced by many thinkers' → advanced가 원문. (C) 'show why we should conclude that the universe has a creator' → conclude가 원문. → ①(A)illustrate-(B)advanced-(C)conclude.

(A) 'Analogies can serve two different functions' → functions가 원문. (B) 'the analogy can be an integral part of an argument' → integral이 원문. (C) 'the universe implies the existence of a divine creator' → implies가 원문. → ③(A)functions-(B)integral-(C)implies.

(A) 'he may simply be using the image of the sun' → image가 원문. (B) 'the most popular arguments for the existence of God' → popular이 원문. (C) 'the universe implies the existence of a divine creator' → divine이 원문. → ④(A)image-(B)popular-(C)divine.
④reject: 'the analogy is supposed to reject why we should conclude' → 원문은 show. reject(거부)는 반대. ①illustrate, ②existence, ③meant는 적절.
②optional: 'the analogy can be an optional part of an argument' → 원문은 integral(핵심적인). optional(선택적)은 반대. ①arguments, ③thinkers, ④creator는 적절.
②dismissed: 'which has been dismissed by many thinkers' → 원문은 advanced(발전됨). dismissed(기각됨)는 반대. ①compares, ③implies, ④show는 적절.
'the analogy can be an ____ part of an argument' → 논증의 핵심 부분. integral(③=필수적인). minor(사소한), decorative(장식적), disputed(논쟁된)는 반대.
'just as an artefact such as a watch ____ the existence of an artisan, so the universe ____ the existence of a divine creator' → implies(①=암시한다). denies(부정), predicts(예측), eliminates(제거)는 부적합.
'the argument from design...which has been ____ by many thinkers, from the ancient Stoics to William Paley' → advanced(④=발전시켜온). rejected(거부), ignored(무시), forgotten(잊혀진)는 반대.
illustrate = 설명하다, 예시하다. demonstrate(③=보여주다, 설명하다)가 동의어. complicate(복잡하게), contradict(모순), memorize(암기)는 다른 의미.
integral = 핵심적인, 필수적인. essential(①=필수적인)이 동의어. temporary(일시적), superficial(피상적), controversial(논쟁적)은 다른 의미.
implies = 암시한다. suggests(④=암시하다)가 동의어. demands(요구), prevents(막다), eliminates(제거)는 다른 의미.
popular = 유명한, 인기 있는. 반의어는 obscure(③=잘 알려지지 않은). famous(유명한), common(흔한), ancient(고대)는 유사어 또는 다른 의미.
advanced = 발전시킨. 반의어는 hindered(④=방해받은). promoted(촉진), extended(확장), modified(수정)는 유사어.
(A) 'Analogies can serve two different functions' → serve = 수행하다(역할을). (B) 'he may simply be using the image of the sun to help bring to life his arguments' — '제공하다' 맥락 → 수행하다. → (A)수행하다 (B)제공하다 = ①.
'comparison between two similar things to explain something' = analogy(②=유추). metaphor(은유), hypothesis(가설), paradox(역설)은 다른 의미.
전치사 for 뒤 명사 자리. exist(동사) → existence(명사). 'arguments for the existence of God'.
'he may ____ be using the image' — be using을 수식하는 부사. simple(형용사) → simply(부사).

'just as an artefact such as a watch implies the existence of an artisan, so ____' → 유추 결론: 'the universe implies the existence of a divine creator'(③). the watch needs a new design(①), philosophy requires more analogies(②), Socrates compared the Good(④)는 부적합.

'he may simply be using the image of the sun to ____' — 소크라테스의 의도. 'help bring to life his arguments about the Good'(②)가 원문. prove the sun is ultimate Good(①), disprove divine creator(③), replace philosophical reasoning(④)는 부적합.
